title: Policy Fee Share for Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance Owners — Term Life Insurance Accidental Death Rider Expiry
content:
**Term Life Insurance relationship terms.** In the installment after the accidental death rider ends, the policy fee share follows the owner's other Ashgrove life policies on the owner's Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance records: nothing of the fee is charged when the owner holds both an in-force Ashgrove whole life policy and an in-force Ashgrove universal life policy, one half (0.5) of it when the owner holds exactly one of the two in force, and the whole of it otherwise.

| Hypothetical owner | Share |
|---|---|
| in-force Ashgrove 10-Pay Whole Life and in-force Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier | nothing |
| in-force Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL only | one half |
| a whole life policy that lapsed, nothing else | the whole fee |
